name: AI Accounts
short_desc: External: Connect your Claude subscription once; your agents on this server use it.
author: Humanity Labs
description: The one place to connect AI subscriptions for your Wizard server. Phase 1: your Claude Pro or Max subscription, signed in with Anthropic's official Claude Code login. Hermes Agent (Wizard build) then uses it through NousResearch's official Claude Subscription plugin. ChatGPT sign-in and API keys are coming later. Your sign-in stays in a private shared folder and is never shown or sent anywhere by this app.

form_fields.label: Page password (optional)
form_fields.hint: Leave empty on a Tailscale-only server. If set (use 16+ characters), your browser asks for it (any username) before showing this page.
